fair_value_reason: 444.1M shares; about $20M attributable net debt; Copper Mountain 100%. 2027E EBITDA of about $1.55B, built from verified H1 2026 EBITDA of $743M: about 155kt Cu, about 240koz Au, a deck of about $5.75 Cu and $3,900 Au. Methods: consolidated 7x EV/EBITDA gives $24.4; P/E of about $1.60 x 15 gives $24; SOTP (operations 6.25x $1.55B + Copper World 70% about $1.45B + Cactus about $1.05B) gives about $27.6. Blended, that is about $26, down from my round-1 $27 because H1 data and flat gold guidance put $1.6B at the top of the reasonable EBITDA range. The forecaster round-2 mean is $25.5.

thesis_triggers.event: About -39%, at the agents' modal level ($16 for agents 1, 3 and 5; $16.5 for agent_2; $17 for agent_4). At $16 the market cap (about $7.1B) is under 5x a haircut 2027E EBITDA of about $1.5B, with no credit for Copper World (the Mitsubishi deal implies at least about $1.4B for Hudbay's 70%) or Cactus (about $1.14B paid in shares). Trading there would signal a durable copper break below about $4.75/lb, a Copper World capex or funding shock forcing equity issuance, a failed Copper Mountain ramp, or a Constancia/Peru disruption. It sits above the $14.34 52-week low.

supervisor_summary: In round 2 all five forecasters applied the filing-backed corrections. Fair values now cluster at $24.4-26.6 (mean $25.5), all below my round-1 $27, because each uses a haircut metals deck and an execution-haircut volume. That is independent agreement, since they moved in both directions from their round-1 numbers. The 1-month agreement, though, is my round-1 framing repeated five times. The new facts the agents introduced check out against the filings: the company's own 2027 deck of $5.80 / $4,200, H1 EBITDA of $743M, H1 copper of 56.2kt, BC Q2 costs of $3.22/lb, the 2022 dismissal of the federal suits, the contingent Section 232 tariff, and the Fujimori government. I trimmed my fair value to $26 and slightly fattened the 12-month left tail; otherwise the mean stands. P(>=$26) is about 52%, and the thesis breaks at $16.
key_drivers: Copper and gold prices: spot Cu about $6.5-6.6/lb and Au about $4,160-4,190. The company's own 2027 assumption is $5.80 / $4,200. Gold was about 38% of Q2 revenue, and 2027 gold ounces are guided flat (213-269koz).

Delivery of the guided copper step-up: 140-184kt in 2027 vs 110-138kt in 2026 (BC 50-70kt vs 25-35kt). H1 2026 ran at 56.2kt, so Q3 (late October) and Copper Mountain costs ($3.22/lb in Q2) are the first checks.
Copper World DFS capex and sanction (guided late 2026; capex above the 2023 PFS), with Mitsubishi's $180M due by about July 2027.
Balance sheet: about $20M attributable net debt and $743M of H1 2026 adjusted EBITDA. The growth pipeline is funded without equity, unless Copper World capex shocks.
Policy: a possible Section 232 15% refined-copper tariff from 2027-01-01 (contingent, undecided), and Peru's new Fujimori government (pro-mining, but with unrest risk).
